sentences.text: Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in criminal case having FIR No.121 dated 3.6.2022 registered under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC at Police Station Dharamkot, District Moga.

Present case is relating to execution of one sale deed alleged to be executed by co-accused Pritam Kaur impersonating herself as Prito daughter of Sunder Singh who was the original owner of the land in question and that the present petitioner attested the said sale deed as its witness being Numberdar.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation with the police in compliance of previous order of interim bail.

State counsel on instructions from ASI Jasbir Singh has not refuted the aforesaid assertions made by the counsel for the petitioner and further submits Sukhpalsingh Numberdar vs State Of Punjab on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60731457/
1 that the petitioner is not required by the police for further 1 of 2 CRM-M-53779-2022 (O&M)
investigation or custodial interrogation.

entities.text: Sukhpalsingh Numberdar vs State Of Punjab
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and order of interim bail dated 21.11.2022 is hereby made absolute subject to the conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
 ( KARAMJIT SINGH)
 JUDGE January 20, 2023 Paritosh Kumar
